args.title: Halvorsen Supply newsletter + linked article + companion piece
args.body:
- Newsletter (Halvorsen Supply, "Warehouse automation in 2026"): This week's issue covers warehouse automation in 2026, linking to the full article at blog.halvorsen.example/2026/warehouse and offering free registration (no password needed) for the companion piece.
- Linked article ("Warehouse automation in 2026"): Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece (insights.halvorsen.example/warehouse/companion, registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example): The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
